item.title: A Billion-Parameter Music Model: What 23x More Parameters Bought
item.dc:creator: Khashayar Ghamati
item.description: Part 2 of the Music-LLM series. I scaled a text-to-music transformer from 45 million to 1 billion parameters, trained it on two GPUs, and measured what the extra parameters actually bought.

item.title: Building a Small Transformer That Makes Music
item.dc:creator: Khashayar Ghamati
item.description: Part 1 of the Music-LLM series. Building a 45M-parameter text-to-music model by hand in PyTorch - EnCodec tokens, cross-attention, home-made pipeline parallelism on two GPUs, and the silent PCIe bug that nearly stopped it. With real training curves and generated audio.
